# Kapwing

> > Kapwing is an AI-powered online video editing platform that enables creators to quickly generate, edit, and repurpose video content for social media and professional use.

Kapwing provides a comprehensive suite of AI video tools including a main editor, auto-subtitling, dubbing, transcription, and content repurposing features. The platform supports creators in generating and editing videos for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and other platforms with minimal technical expertise.

## Key Topics

- AI Video Editor
- Video Editing
- Auto-Subtitles
- AI Dubbing
- Content Repurposing
- Video Transcription
- AI Clip Maker

- Social Media Content
- AI-Powered Tools
- Online Video Creation
- Multi-Language Support

## Core Video Editing

- [Kapwing: Make a Video About Anything](https://www.kapwing.com): Kapwing homepage showcasing AI video generation and editing platform for creators
- [Online Video Editor — Fast, No-Download Editing](https://www.kapwing.com/video-editor): Kapwing's main video editor with AI, auto-subtitles, drag-and-drop interface
- [AI Video Editor — Free. Fast. Online.](https://www.kapwing.com/ai): Kapwing's AI video editor with trim, subtitles, B-roll generation
- [Tools — Kapwing](https://www.kapwing.com/tools): Directory of Kapwing tools including video editor, meme generator, subtitler

## AI Video Generation & Transformation

- [AI Video Tools — Kapwing AI for Creators & Teams](https://www.kapwing.com/ai/overview): Overview of Kapwing's AI tools for video generation and editing
- [AI Clip Maker + Generator: Try for Free](https://www.kapwing.com/ai/clip-maker): AI tool to convert long videos into short viral clips
- [Repurpose Video Content — AI-powered Studio](https://www.kapwing.com/tools/repurpose): AI tool to repurpose content for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram automatically
- [AI B-Roll Generator — Instant Video Footage](https://www.kapwing.com/ai/b-roll-generator): AI B-roll generator sourcing footage from iStock, Pexels, Pixabay
- [AI Video Script Generator — Free Online Scripts](https://www.kapwing.com/ai/script-generator): AI script generator for YouTube, TikTok, ads, and podcasts
- [AI Song Generator — Instant Studio-Quality Songs](https://www.kapwing.com/ai/generator/audio/song): AI music generator creating studio-quality songs in any genre

## Audio & Subtitle Tools

- [Auto-Subtitle Generator — 99% Accurate (Free)](https://www.kapwing.com/subtitles): AI-powered auto-subtitle tool supporting SRT, MP4 export formats
- [Online Audio Editor — Professional Audio in Seconds](https://www.kapwing.com/tools/audio-editor): AI audio editor with background noise removal and voice enhancement
- [Text to Speech Generator — Free & Online Video Maker](https://www.kapwing.com/tools/text-to-speech): AI text-to-speech with voice cloning via ElevenLabs integration
- [Video to Text Converter — Transcribe Video to Text for Free](https://www.kapwing.com/tools/transcribe): Video transcription tool supporting multiple file formats
- [Remove Background Noise From Audio and Video — Online](https://www.kapwing.com/tools/remove-background/noise): One-click background noise removal for audio and video projects

## Dubbing & Translation

- [AI Dubbing — Free Online Video Dubbing](https://www.kapwing.com/ai/dubbing): AI dubbing tool with 40+ languages and automatic lip-sync
- [Video Translator — Quickly Translate With AI](https://www.kapwing.com/tools/translate): AI video translator supporting 100+ languages with dubbing

## Advanced Editing Features

- [Text-Based Video Editor: Edit Video by Editing Text](https://www.kapwing.com/ai/text-based-video-editor): AI tool to edit video by removing text from transcript
- [AI Speaker Focus: Auto Framing for Video](https://www.kapwing.com/ai/auto-speaker-focus): Auto-framing AI tool for podcasts, webinars, and interviews
- [Online Video Resizer: Resize Videos for Free (Fast)](https://www.kapwing.com/tools/resize): Video resizer with presets for Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook
